content.rendered:
Don’t feel like cooking?  Want to help raise money for our school?  Join us Wednesday, September 11th, 4:00-8:00pm, for Dinner Night Out!  25% of event sales are donated to Hawks View PAC.  Order online for pickup using Code 39R2LRX, or show this FLYER in the restaurant.

  • Sherwood Chipotle – 21332 SW Langer Farms Pkway, Ste 118
  • September 11th 
  • 4:00-8:00 pm
